name: Aminata Diallo
action: She politely accepts Sékou's invitation to join his family for the Korité meal tonight.
reason: Aminata is exhausted and behind on study time, but this invitation does not require an extra bus fare and comes from a trusted mentor whose wife has already sent greetings. Her memory of Korité meals with her mother, plus her recollection of later regretting missed family connection, makes her more likely to value this holiday invitation despite her usual preference for studying.
